test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a central problem of economy?
solution:
The answer is **When to produce**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **When to produce:**

 
 
• This is not considered a central problem of the economy. Central problems typically revolve around the allocation of resources and distribution of goods and services, rather than the timing of production.
 
• In a financial enterprise, timing can be relevant for inventory management or market strategy, but it does not address the core economic questions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **For whom to produce:**

 
 
• This is a central economic problem that addresses the distribution of goods and services among different segments of society.
 
• It involves decisions about targeting different consumer groups, which is crucial for financial enterprises aiming to maximize market reach and profitability.
 
 
 
• **What to produce:**
 
 
• This is another core economic issue that involves deciding which goods and services should be produced based on consumer needs and resource availability.
 
• Financial enterprises must determine the most profitable products or services to offer to meet market demand.
 
 
 
• **How to produce:**
 
 
• This problem focuses on the methods and processes of production, including the technology and resources used.
 
• For financial enterprises, this could mean choosing the most efficient operational processes to minimize costs and maximize output.
